glosses: Arising or originating from a figure of authority.

examples.text: The authoritative rules in this school come not from the headmaster but from the aged matron.

glosses: Highly accurate or definitive; treated or worthy of treatment as a scholarly authority.

examples.text: This book is the world's most authoritative guide to insect breeding habits.
He instructed us in that booming, authoritative voice of his.
